messages:
Alex: quick heads-up — want to prototype a small console nudge showing 'permission coverage' during tenant rollouts. idea: show % of routes/scopes a role actually allows vs what the tenant intends to migrate. helps spot gaps before full cutover.
Priya: short + actionable UI sounds good. do we mean coverage per-role or per-route?
Alex: per-role with optional drilldown to routes. top-level card: Role X — 82% coverage (12 missing routes). click -> list.
Marco: telemetry question: how do we compute coverage without leaking PII or route contents? sampling? aggregate counts?
Jess: could do hashed route ids + counts, or only send counts grouped by product area. we already collect route metrics; reuse that.
Liam: also need to consider quota-sensitive customers — collecting route usage might be sensitive. opt-in for private deployments?
Priya: agreed. for Hosted and Dedicated we can default opt-in, provide easy toggle in tenant settings. Private deploys must opt-in explicitly. add a clear privacy banner.
Alex: from infra/API side: i'd prefer adding a lightweight endpoint: GET /internal/telemetry/role-coverage?role_id=foo returns {total_routes: 140, covered: 115, groups: {ingest:80/70, query:60/45}}. no route names, only counts and group keys.
Marco: internal API change is fine, but we should avoid adding heavy DB joins on request path. precompute nightly + on-demand incremental update when role or route changes.
Jess: UI mock: show sparkline of coverage over last 30d, and a small list of top missing groups. clicking 'show example routes' must only show anonymized examples (prefix-only).
Alex: putting a draft payload here so backend + frontend align:
```
{
  "role_id": "r_123",
  "total_routes": "140",
  "covered_routes": "115",
  "coverage_pct": "82",
  "groups": ["ingest:70/60","query:70/55"]
}
```
Marco: that payload seems fine; prefer numbers as ints but string is ok for early prototype. also add a last_updated timestamp.
Priya: rollout plan idea: feature-flag the UI and surface telemetry to 10% of orgs, then 50% after we verify perf and privacy. send an automated survey in the product HUD asking if the info was useful.
Liam: telemetry sampling: for cost reasons, only sample high-cardinality routes. for low-volume tenants compute exact; for high-volume tenants sample 10% and estimate. mark sampled estimates in UI with an icon and tooltip.
Jess: UX caveat — avoid alarming language like 'missing' or 'incomplete' for customers who intentionally restrict routes. use neutral phrasing: 'not covered by this role'. add a link to run a preflight check.
Alex: ops question: do we need an RBAC change to allow console viewers to see coverage? probably only tenant-admins and roles with role.read.
Marco: yes, check our permission model — we can gate by existing role.read on /roles and add a telemetry.view scope if needed. minimal expansion preferred.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: telemetry-service/coverage-precalc v0.3 -> canary (10% tenants) scheduled in 15m :rocket:
Priya: canary timing good. Marco + Alex, can you add perf budget: < 200ms for on-demand API, nightly job < 2m runtime for 95% of tenants?
Marco: noted — will add metrics and alerts. will also emit a sample-rate tag for cost tracking.
Liam: leaving a note to update docs and privacy policy snippets. i'll draft language and share here tomorrow.
Alex: perfect — thanks all. i'll drop a quick console mock later today.
Jess: excited to try the sparkline. :eyes:
Priya: moving to RFC once mock is in.
Alex: closing thread for now, will reopen if any infra blockers appear.
